service.description: Run one Agent Code command (plans/agent-code/02-Orchestration.md section 1) for the current user, who needs AgentCodeUse. The command is a map with type, commandId (1 to 40 letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.') and the fields of its type. The rows, the changes for the shell stream, the effects and a receipt are written in one transaction; a commandId with a receipt answers the stored result again (replayed true) and writes nothing. A command on a thread locks the thread's row first. On a refusal the error is on the message list and errorCode names it: invalid_command, unknown_command, internal_only, not_found, conflict, forbidden or failed.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: threadId and the thread's new summary, for most commands

service.description: dispatch#Command for the server's own code, which may also send the internal command types (such as thread.title.regeneration.complete). Not allowed remotely.
